historical_record.description: Under its discretionary review powers, the City Planning Commission refused, 4-0, to allow demolition of the architecturally significant two-storey, two-family house until a building permit that could be approved was before it, and continued the replacement building's permit.

Under its discretionary review powers, the City Planning Commission approved, 5-0, demolishing the architecturally significant two-storey, two-family house for a new two-storey-over-garage two-family building, having refused the demolition in September until a replacement it could approve was before it.
